note: Singing-modes step 2: Mixolydian as the major scale with a ♭7, the ♭7 sung from under Do and from Sol on two staffs a step and a half apart, then a made-up tune that lands on the ♭7 as {{chord:bVII}} comes round (chords as tokens, counted the long way). The second key is written in, not moves, because the ♭7 under Do only fits a tenor's staff in keys from about D up; the tempo is moves (70 up to 90). missing: a way for moves to keep a block to the keys where notes under Do fit.

exercise.title: Mixolydian over a drone
exercise.why: Mixolydian is the major scale with one note changed, the ♭7, so the mode is in tune when that one note is: sing it against the drone from above and from below, then land on it over the chord built on it.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. This is the major scale with its 7th note a half step lower: {{b7}}, ringed on the staff. Sing the scale from the low {{1}} up to the next {{1}} and back down. Sing it on "oo".
Go slowly past {{b7}}, and listen for it settling against the drone.

Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Sing {{1}}, step down to the {{b7}} under it, and come back to {{1}}. Then sing {{5}}, up to {{b7}}, and on up to {{1}}. Sing them on "ah".
Practice until {{b7}} lands without a slide from both sides.

Press Play on the second staff below to start its drone. Then press Start microphone. Sing the same two moves from its {{1}}.
When the key changes, the drone moves and {{b7}} is still a whole step under {{1}}.

Press Start exercise below: the mic and the backing track start together, at {{=bpm}}. The backing track plays {{chord:I}}, {{chord:bVII}}, {{chord:IV}} and {{chord:I}} again.
{{chord:I}} is the 1st chord of the key, built on {{1}}, {{chord:bVII}} is the chord built on {{b7}}, and {{chord:IV}} is the 4th chord, built on {{4}}. Make up a short tune from the scale, and land on {{b7}} when {{chord:bVII}} comes round. Sing it on "la".
If you lose your place, hold {{1}} until {{chord:I}} comes back.
